title: Buyer Term, Escrow Window and Pending-Order Lapse Periods for Bridgewell Closing Plans
content:
Three periods of the Real Estate Service Contracts plans are fixed per plan: the length of buyer coverage, the escrow payment window after closing, and the period after which an unclosed buyer-only order lapses.

## Period schedule

| Plan | Buyer term (calendar months from the closing date) | Escrow payment window (calendar days after closing) | Pending buyer-only order lapse (calendar days after the expected closing date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | 12 | 30 | 90 |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | 12 | 30 | 90 |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | 12 | 30 | 90 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | 12 | 30 | 90 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | 24 | 30 | 90 |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | 36 | 30 | 90 |

## What each period is

- **Buyer term**: the length of buyer coverage counted from the closing date, in calendar months.
- **Escrow payment window**: the calendar days after closing within which the plan invoice must be paid to keep buyer coverage.
- **Pending buyer-only order lapse**: the calendar days after the expected closing date after which an unclosed buyer-only order lapses.

## Points of reading

- The Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year plan runs 24 months of buyer coverage and the Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan runs 36 months; the other four plans run 12 months.
- The escrow payment window (30 days) and the pending-order lapse period (90 days) are the same on all six plans.
